title: Isomerization of pirazolopyrimidines to pyrazolopyridines by ring-opening/closing reaction in aqueous NaOH
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,2078-2085
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA06345G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Carlos Cifuentes, Nestor Bravo, Daniel Restrepo, Mario Macías, Jaime Portilla
Herein, a NaOH-promoted isomerization of pirazolopyrimidines to pyrazolopyridines, arising via an ANRORC mechanism studied using DFT, and the products' synthetic and photophysical utility are provided.
